label: Trees
summary: Which lidar crowns become trees: roofs suppressed, each stem's height, crown radius and broadleaf/conifer kind, rocks left out, closed stands made woodland floor, and what the trees export moves or drops before Unity picks the models.
steps: Lidar canopy (golfpipe canopy): per 1 m cell the highest return minus the mean ground height; cells 2 m or more up where under 10 % of the returns come from multi-return pulses, in patches of 15 m² or more, are roofs and are zeroed (a pulse on a roof comes back once, one into foliage splits).

The cleaned canopy grid (heights clamped to 0..40 m, under 1 m dropped, small gaps closed, each cell its local crown top) gives the canopy tiles and the woodland stands: 3 m+ canopy bridged over 5 m, kept 5 m off roofs, at least 2500 m² and half covered becomes a woodland_floor zone.

Stems (golfpipe trees-stems) come from the roof-suppressed heights, not the cleaned grid: cells 1 m or more up are smoothed, each local top seeds a crown and a watershed shares the cells out; a crown needs 4 m² of cells, or 2 m² when its top reaches 3 m, and a tall crown under 12 m² must be more than 3 m from a roof cell.

A stem's height is the top of its own crown; its crown radius is the equal-area circle, capped at 0.35 x height (but at least 1.5 m, at most 10 m); a flat, compact crown keeps its equal-area radius, and a flat low lobe beside a tall tree becomes a stem of its own.

Kind comes from the newest leaf-off ortho (every date Oct-Apr): the upper crown's greenness (G - R) / (R + G + B) is ramped 0.02..0.12 to a conifer score; 0.5 or more is conifer, less broadleaf; a score within 0.05 of 0.5, too little photo, or a stem under 4 m is unknown.

Rock filter: a stem under 5 m whose returns are almost all single pulses and whose leaf-off pixels are pale and grey is no tree (a boulder, a shed, a car, a wall); it is left out and written beside the stems as a rock candidate.

The trees export (gspro.py trees) keeps the stems on the terrain's square and flags a crown wider than 0.35 x its height as a bush; a stem on or within 0.8 m of a drawn path is moved just outside it; stems in a power line's corridor (+3 m) are dropped, and so are stems under 6 m on a rock slab (+0.5 m; not a riseMode dem cliff) or a placed rock.
Each stem inside a drawn tree species area takes that area's id; where areas overlap the topmost one wins.

In Unity (GolfMapBiome.cs, twin unity/tree-matching.mjs) the course's docs/gspro/<course>/palette.json rules pick the model: a stem up to shrubMaxHeightM is a shrub, taller a tree; only models of that form and the stem's kind count (unknown takes either), each scaled to fit the height and crown width.

Species: inside a tree area its mix races by weight (when it has a model of the stem's form); elsewhere the palette's speciesWeights race among the species that fit within speciesFitSlack of the best, and unknown-kind stems skip the weights; a tree with woodlandMinNeighbours others within woodlandRadiusM fits as woodland; every pick hashes the stem's id, so a replant gives the same trees.
The planter (GolfMapTreePlanter.cs) leaves out stems within 1 m of a placed building and stems under any other placed prop; hand-edited stems stay.

Arborist (pipeline/arborist.py, docs/gspro/<course>/arborist-species.json): prefabs named under vsp stay in VSP, the rest become Arborist items; trees beyond billboardBeyondM (outside the boundary and away from play) are billboard-only, and outerKeep thins those far ones.
